faq.q: Can I start with one product and add others later?
faq.a: Yes. All products share the same employee record, so adding one does not mean loading data again.

faq.q: What about what is coming soon?
faq.a: You can ask us to let you know. It is not charged until it is available and you turn it on.

faq.q: Is my data separate from other companies?
faq.a: Yes. Each organization's data is isolated and every access to sensitive data is logged.

home.closing_text: Pick a plan, add what you need and create your organization in minutes.

personas.headline: Digital records and up-to-date contracts
personas.description: Complete employee records, contracts with expiry alerts, org chart and documents in one place. It is the base of every GestiaHR product.
features: Contracts, renewals and addenda with alerts

faq.q: Can I buy People on its own?
faq.a: No need: Gestia People comes in every plan because it is the base of the system.

tiempo.headline: Vacation, absences and working time
tiempo.description: Vacation balances, requests with approval, absences, medical leave and statutory leave. Attendance, shifts and timesheets are coming soon.
features: Remote work and right to disconnect

faq.q: Do I need Time to use Payroll?
faq.a: Yes. Payroll uses the period's vacation and absences, so Payroll requires Time.

planilla.headline: Payroll, payslips and filings
planilla.description: Payroll calculation with bonuses, severance fund and settlements, payslips for employees and the files for SUNAT and your bank.

faq.q: Is Payroll sold on its own?
faq.a: It comes inside the plans that include Time, or as an add-on to a plan that already has it.

talento.headline: Recruiting, performance and careers
talento.description: Recruiting, onboarding, performance reviews, career plans and compensation in the same system.

faq.q: Can I ask to be notified?
faq.a: Yes. Leave your interest and we will let you know when each part is available.

formacion.headline: Your own courses and certificates
formacion.description: Upload your courses, assign them by job or area and keep track of who completed what. It does not include a third-party course library.
